entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She's just past that dining room-[n]looking place! Let's go!

entries.speaker: Ann's Voice
entries.en: *gasp*

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This way!

entries.speaker: Ann's Voice
entries.en: Is this some kind of filming!? Who's in[n]charge here!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She totally doesn't get what's goin' on!

entries.speaker: Ann's Voice
entries.en: Look, I'll apologize for touching the armor[n]without permission!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How much stupider can she get?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's hurry! We have to save her!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You ready?
I'm good to go.
One sec.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, let's go!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Make it quick.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We have no idea what awaits us ahead...[n]Here, you'd better take these.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: These fine tools have my seal of[n]approval! Use them wisely, all right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa—there's one here too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, now that we've expanded our[n]roster, let's try that thing!
That thing?
What're you scheming?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A way for us to gain the advantage[n]during a battle.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's called a "Baton Pass"!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Actually, I'll show you what I mean[n]while we deal with this Shadow.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Great teamwork! I knew you guys[n]would nail it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Improving yourselves is important, but[n]learning to fight as a team is just as vital[n]to our survival.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: By coordinating our efforts, we can take[n]control of the battle as often as possible.[n]Baton Passes will help a lot with that!
